summary: The fund normally invests at least 80% of the fund's assets in equity securities included in the index and in depositary receipts representing securities included in the index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of a global universe of companies engaged in activities related to cryptocurrency, related blockchain technology and digital payments processing. The fund is non-diversified.
